name: Push-Up to Side Plank
steps: Begin in a high-plank position on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and feet hip-width apart.
Lower your chest smoothly toward the floor and press back up to a strong straight-arm plank.
Pivot onto the edges of your feet, turn your chest sideways and reach your top hand toward the ceiling.
Lower your top hand smoothly back to the floor, perform another push-up, and rotate to the opposite side, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Rotate your hips and shoulders together as one unit rather than letting your lower back sag.
Stack your supporting shoulder directly above your wrist during the side-plank pause.
